tei:titleStmt.tei:title: אֱלֹהַי נְשָׁמָה (נוסח אנגליה)
Elohai Neshamah, the complete daily vidui as found in the Ets Ḥayyim of Jacob Jehudah Ḥazzan on London (1287)

tei:div.tei:head: Elohai Neshamah, the complete daily vidui as found in the Ets Ḥayyim of Jacob Jehudah Ḥazzan on London (1287)

tei:lg.tei:l: My elo’ah
the neshamah that you granted me
is pure –
you shaped it
you formed it
you breathed it into me
you look after it within me
and in time, you will take it from me
and in time, you will return it to me
in the time that is coming.
As long as the neshamah is suspended within me
I am grateful to you YHVH my elo’ah and elo’ah of my ancestors
for I am not so bold and arrogant to declare before you:
“YHVH my elo’ah and elo’ah of my ancestors,
I am clean and I have not transgressed.” –
For what profits a lying tongue?!
and what advantage is there for the speaker
to say before you: “my doctrine is pure” (Job 11:4)
and “I have done no wrong”? (Cf. Proverbs 30:20)
Is it possible for a stonecutter to build a city
with hidden places capable of concealing its residents from your face?
Yes, YHVH our elo’ah,
I cannot disregard you
for you measure my activity and my rest
and you behold my conscience
Therefore I said to my heart
“It is good to thank YHVH
and to grant thanks to my elo’ah”
and to say, “El na refa na li (El, please heal me, please)” (Cf. Numbers 12:13)
for that which I was foolish
and for that which I transgressed.
Guilty am I –
I ate forbidden food
and without any prayer.
I betrayed,
I invalidated your Torah
I took honor in the disgrace of my friend.
I committed unspeakable sexual crimes,
I robbed,
I thieved.
I spoke falsehood, lies, slander, and idle gossip.
I publicly humiliated and shamed my friend
I bent judgement,
and I sinned and I caused evil.
I was wanton –
I whored
I lusted,
I was violent.
I desecrated the Shabbat and your Holy Name.
I framed [the innocent] with lies
I defiled my soul.
I gave wicked advice.
I honored those who violated your desire.
I was arrogant.
I deceived
I mocked the name of my friend
I raged.
I was careless,
I have not attended to your mitsvot.
I rebelled,
I despised your words.
I derided,
I cuckolded,
I vowed falsely
I strayed
I cheated
I distorted the proper way.
I perverted,
I acted unjustly.
I committed crime
I behaved falsely.
I was hostile
I stalked my companion
and I strode toward evil.
I was disdainful
I called my companions unfriendly names.
I was wicked,
I ran after evil,
I pursued profit.
I shed blood
I corrupted.
I deviated
I despised
I swindled.
I have strayed from your commands and your good laws
I have corrupted what is right and I have not paid back for it (Job 33:27)
And you are just (in delivering) all that comes upon me
for you are the author of Truth
and I have been found guilty.
What can I say before you enthroned on high
and what can I relay before you who dwells in Shḥaqim
For is not all that is hidden and revealed known to you?
You know the secrets of the cosmos
and the mysteries hidden to all that is alive
You search all our innermost thoughts
and probe our mind and conscience.
Nothing is hidden from you
and nothing is concealed from your perspective
May it be your will
YHVH my elo’ah and elo’ah of my ancestors
that you may forgive me all of my crimes
and pardon me all of my transgressions
and expiate all of my sins
If I have sinned, what have I done to you, Watcher of Humanity? (Job 7:20)
How shall I greet and approach my elo’ah on high?
If with teshuvah and Torah
then behold, I have repented my crimes before you
and I have said,
I have sinned
I have corrupted
I have committed crimes
I have corrupted what was right and I have not paid back for it. (Job 33:27)
And if misfortune you give
behold, my complacency is shattered within me
much hardship did I find
and if, with tears and pleas
here my spirit weeps in the chambers of the furious Creator.
El na refa na lah! (El, please heal her, please!) (Numbers 12:13)
for I have corrupted and sinned and committed crimes before you
If you should mark iniquities Yah YHVH, who could stand?
Surely, a human being will sin against their fellow
and how then can one be purified of their deeds?
[The One] that charges (even) his angels with folly
and, in (their) eyes, Heaven would not pardon
how much less man, a worm,
the son-of-man, a maggot (Job 25:6)
whose founding was the dust and to the dust will return,
[as it is written,] “Then he would return to Ramah,
for his home was there” (I Samuel 7:17).
Therefore YHVH my elo’ah
Take away the iniquity of my transgressions,
and blot out my iniquities,
and have mercy on me
to reanimate me at the time you will bring your creatures to judgement
for from you my praise and my prayer come forth
and you are prepared to bring together each bone
and to place within them tendons
and to strengthen them with muscle
and to cover them over with skin
and to place within them breath
and to restore souls within their corpses
Blessed are you Restorer of Souls to dead bodies.

tei:note.tei:p: Soul. Here an embodied entity distinguished from literal breath.
lit. distorted and paled my friend’s face in public)
”I was obnoxious” or “I pranked” might fit here also.
A name for the sky or Heaven.
lit. your eyes. Cf. YK musaf, 10 martyrs
Cf. Job 4:18. A reference to the fate of the Nefilim, established in the midrash of Shemḥazai and Azael, as well as early extracanonical works, Enoch, Jubilees, etc.
paraphrasing Job 4:17. Find note immediately prior.

An unfamiliar midrashic reference to the material earth as origin and destination of Adam. If you know of another use of this verse in the context of burial (and ultimately, resurrection), please leave a comment or contact us.
